question: Do explicit reasoning and a separate reviewing agent improve evidence labeling and verified display configuration under equal resource ceilings?

arm_definitions.rules: Deterministic solver for the stated task rules; no language model; transparent task-specific ceiling/baseline
arm_definitions.reasoning: Same weights, tools, task and sampling with enable_thinking=True
arm_definitions.self_review: Reasoning agent followed by one generic self-review continuation in its existing conversation
arm_definitions.two_agents: Reasoning planner followed by a separate reasoning reviewer context receiving the task, executed tool trace, and draft; same model weights

case_selection: First 32 V sources by SHA256(seed|source_id), one source per group and date, excluding all three published acoustic anecdotes; no acoustic-quality or agent-outcome selection
source_scope: Reused acoustic-development partition V; new agent tasks/outcomes, not an untouched acoustic final test; actual C/test remain unopened
smoke_cases: Two disjoint G sources for transport, parser and runtime checks only; all smoke outputs retained and excluded from scores
family_assignment: Cyclic in the frozen source order, eight cases each
mask: Main 500 ms artificial gap [1.75,2.25); fragmented family additionally erases the first 16 ms of each 64/160 ms block, alternating by family instance
setting_rule: Choose the shortest window meeting frequency-bin spacing, maximum time support, and at least three wholly observed frames in both requested regions; decline when no setting qualifies
label_rule: If no setting qualifies, or either chosen-window region has peak prominence below 10 dB, use insufficient. Otherwise use stable when peak-bin separation is <= one chosen-window bin and absolute band-level change is <=6 dB; use changed otherwise. These are stipulated observed-cue labels, not vessel classes or continuity inside erased audio.
identity_rule: Source identity remains unknown; dataset annotations and missing reference samples are never provided to any agent
primary_endpoint: Strict task success: valid structured report, correct feasible/decline decision and optimal setting, correct observed-cue label, evidence-backed numeric report, executed post-configuration verification when feasible, correct gap/identity status, unchanged input
review_policy: Review starts after the initial final report or four model turns, whichever occurs first; planner receives at most half the shared generated-token allowance. All arms share the same total ceilings; actual consumption is reported. Review receives no evaluator verdict or expected answer.
reasoning_budget_policy: Thinking generation stops at </think> or 512 tokens; when capped, append </think> before generating the action. Record forced closure and count all generated tokens. The direct arm receives the same total ceiling.
feedback_policy: No human corrective feedback, oracle answer, or automatic task-success feedback during evaluation; actual tool errors/results are visible
run_order: Interleave arms per case; rotate the order of the four neural arms with case index; retain every scheduled case and failure
analysis: Paired recording-level success differences with 10000 paired bootstrap resamples; Wilson intervals for proportions; exact two-sided McNemar tests for reasoning-vs-direct, self-review-vs-reasoning, and two-agents-vs-self-review, with Holm correction. One decoding seed; descriptive bounded-task evidence, no general reasoning or physical hardware claim.
stop_policy: Enforce episode caps and the separate ten-hour authorization. If deadline prevents completion, report complete paired blocks and every partial/failure record; never choose favorable cases or reruns.
manuscript_policy: Replace the illustrative CPU-agent subsection/figure with GPU comparative evidence; retain original CPU records as historical supplementary evidence. Keep ten total pages, anonymous, single mainj.tex and colocated figures.
